script_parts.opening: Namaskar, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — kya aap Merhaba Tyres ke owner se baat kar sakta hoon? Ji, main isliye call kar raha hoon kyunki hamare system mein dikha ki pichle 30 dinon mein aapka account sirf 1 din active raha hai — aur aapka BL velocity 82.9% girke negative ho gaya hai, matlab buyers aap tak pahunch hi nahi pa rahe.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, seedha poochna chahta hoon — kya koi specific problem aa rahi hai platform use karne mein, ya business mein itna busy ho gaye hain ki login karne ka time nahi mil raha? Kyunki jab reply rate sirf 6.4% ho aur PNS success 6.8% pe ho, toh buyers frustrated hokar competitor ke paas chale jaate hain.
script_parts.value_demo: Aapka CQS score abhi 21 hai — yeh critical zone mein hai, matlab jab koi buyer IndiaMART pe 'tyres Secunderabad' search karta hai, aapka listing practically invisible ho jaata hai. Agar yeh score 50+ ho jaaye, toh aapki visibility significantly improve hoti hai aur leads khud aane lagte hain.
script_parts.action: Bhai, abhi call pe hi 5 minute mein ek kaam karte hain — main aapko guide karta hoon apna profile open karne mein aur sirf 2-3 catalog images aur contact details verify karne mein, jisse aapka CQS score turant improve hona shuru ho aur aapka account active status mein aa jaaye.
script_parts.close: Aaj ek chhota sa step — profile update aur notifications on kar lein. Kya aap kal ek baar 10 minute nikal sakte hain jab main aapko call karoon aur hum milke leads ka response bhi check kar lein? Koi pressure nahi, bas ek check-in.

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, I'm calling from IndiaMART — am I speaking with the owner of Merhaba Tyres? I'm reaching out because our system flagged that your account was active only 1 day in the last 30 days, and your BL velocity has dropped by 82.9% month-on-month, which means buyers are essentially unable to reach you right now.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask directly — is there a specific challenge with using the platform, or has the business been too busy to log in regularly? Because when the reply rate is just 6.4% and PNS success is at 6.8%, buyers get frustrated and move on to competitors before you even see their inquiry.
script_parts_en.value_demo: Your CQS score is currently 21, which is in the critical zone — practically speaking, when a buyer searches for 'tyres in Secunderabad' on IndiaMART, your listing is nearly invisible to them. Getting that score above 50 would significantly improve your discoverability and bring leads to you organically.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one quick thing together right now on this call — I'll guide you to open your profile and we'll verify just 2-3 catalog images and your contact details in about 5 minutes, which will immediately start improving your CQS score and bring your account back to active status.
script_parts_en.close: Just one small step today — update the profile and turn on lead notifications. Can I call you tomorrow for 10 minutes so we can check together if any leads have come in and respond to them? No pressure, just a quick follow-up check-in.

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
